_note: GST rule pack (I5): the rate slabs the owner may pick from, selected by document date. Every entry records when it was last checked and by whom; verified=false means the official source was not reached (at most 3 may stay so). Never edit an entry after it is verified: add one with a new effectiveFrom.

explain.en: Before 22 September 2025 a supply attracted 0, 5, 12, 18 or 28 per cent GST (with 0.25 and 3 per cent for a few goods).
explain.hi-Latn: 22 September 2025 se pehle GST 0, 5, 12, 18 ya 28 pratishat tha (kuch cheezon par 0.25 aur 3).

entries.verifiedBy: build agent, Stage 3 draft from MASTER-PROMPT 8.2 and the text of the Act and Rules as known; the source URL was not fetched (the build container has no outbound web). Run npm run rules:verify where the web is reachable (the VM): it fetches the source, checks the phrases and records the verification.

explain.en: From 22 September 2025 (the 56th Council's rationalisation) the slabs are 0, 5, 18 and 40 per cent, with 0.25 and 3 per cent special rates.
explain.hi-Latn: 22 September 2025 se (56vi Council) GST 0, 5, 18 ya 40 pratishat hai; 0.25 aur 3 khaas cheezon par.

explain.en: The 57th Council (8 October 2026) recommended compliance changes and no rate change; nothing applies until notified.
